summary: @cathieleblanc I am not even sure what I want is technically possible. Every thing I have been playing with in #indieweb does seem like it's doable. Need to think what the MicroSub student reader would look like. And how an analytics dashboard could work for the teacher.

body_html: @cathieleblanc I am not even sure what I want is technically possible. Every thing I have been playing with in #indieweb does seem like it's doable. Need to think what the MicroSub student reader would look like. And how an analytics dashboard could work for the teacher.
